Both figures pair Llama and Qwen verdicts stored from the Project v1 run with Nemotron's under a different prompt. With all three judges under the deployed prompt and 41% drops, the automated labels give +0.0426 [+0.0264, +0.0593] and the four hand-label cells +0.0323 to +0.0502, three of the four CIs including 0 (A/generous's, [+0.0041, +0.0944], lies above 0); at the cells' own 2.6-9.9% drop shares both give negative point estimates (results/tau_recompute_v1_matched.json, docs/judgebench_v2_protocol_erratum.md). What stands: 128 of 150 automated diagnosis positives still contained the diagnosis, so 0.0706 was measured against wrong labels, and 9 genuine drops cannot show the sign. v2_clean_labels_delta_phi_v (0.122) is gpt-oss-120b's, not Nano's; Nano's v2 figure is 0.0765 (pool_table).
